# ScriptClientWorldRenderer

*Client*

Draws lines, boxes, text, items and blocks in the world for the current frame. It is given by `c.getValue("renderer")`

in the "Client: world render" event, which runs every frame after the world is drawn, and works only during that call: drawings last one frame, so draw them on every call.

Coordinates are world coordinates, changed by the transform of [`translate`](#translate), [`rotateY`](#rotatey) and the like.

[`push()`](#push) saves the transform and [`pop()`](#pop) restores it. Colors are `0xRRGGBB` (opaque) or

`0xAARRGGBB`. Drawings are hidden behind blocks like the world.

```js
function main(c) {
    var r = c.getValue("renderer");

    r.box(0, 64, 0, 1, 65, 1, 0xFF0000);
    r.text("Spawn", 0.5, 66, 0.5);

    // A diamond spinning above the box
    r.push();
    r.translate(0.5, 66.5, 0.5);
    r.rotateY((c.getWorld().getTime() + r.getTickDelta()) * 4);
    r.item("minecraft:diamond", 0, 0, 0, 1);
    r.pop();
}
```

## Methods

### getTickDelta {#gettickdelta}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — part of the current tick passed, from 0 to 1; add it to tick counts for smooth animations

:::

### getCameraPosition {#getcameraposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — world position of the camera

:::

### push {#push}

::: member

Saves the current transform, to restore it with [`pop()`](#pop).

:::

### pop {#pop}

::: member

Restores the transform saved by the last [`push()`](#push).

:::

### translate {#translate}

::: member

Moves the origin of the next drawings.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks along X |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks along Y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | blocks along Z |

:::

### rotateX {#rotatex}

::: member

Turns the next drawings around the X axis through the origin.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `degrees` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | angle by the right-hand rule |

:::

### rotateY {#rotatey}

::: member

Turns the next drawings around the Y axis through the origin.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `degrees` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | angle by the right-hand rule: a positive angle turns `+Z` towards `+X` |

:::

### rotateZ {#rotatez}

::: member

Turns the next drawings around the Z axis through the origin.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `degrees` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | angle by the right-hand rule |

:::

### scale {#scale}

::: member

Scales the next drawings around the origin.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along X |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along Y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale along Z |

:::

### scale {#scale-2}

::: member

Scales the next drawings around the origin equally along all axes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | scale |

:::

### line {#line}

::: member

Draws a line between two points.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the first point |
| `y1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the first point |
| `z1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the first point |
| `x2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the second point |
| `y2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the second point |
| `z2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the second point |
| `color` | [`long`](/scripting/js/Number) | `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |

:::

### box {#box}

::: member

Draws the edges of a box between two corners.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `minX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the lowest corner |
| `minY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the lowest corner |
| `minZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the lowest corner |
| `maxX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the highest corner |
| `maxY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the highest corner |
| `maxZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the highest corner |
| `color` | [`long`](/scripting/js/Number) | `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |

:::

### fillBox {#fillbox}

::: member

Fills a box between two corners; a color with alpha (e.g. `0x80FF0000`) makes it see-through.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `minX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the lowest corner |
| `minY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the lowest corner |
| `minZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the lowest corner |
| `maxX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the highest corner |
| `maxY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the highest corner |
| `maxZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the highest corner |
| `color` | [`long`](/scripting/js/Number) | `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |

:::

### text {#text}

::: member

Draws white text centered on a point, see [`text(Object, double, double, double, long, double)`](#text).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) or any value, shown as plain text |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the point |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the point |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the point |

:::

### text {#text-2}

::: member

Draws text centered on a point, always facing the camera like a name tag, on a dark background. The transform moves the point; its rotation and scale do not apply to the text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style, see `scram.text()`) or any value, shown as plain text |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the point |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the point |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the point |
| `color` | [`long`](/scripting/js/Number) | `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |
| `scale` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | 1 for the size of name tags |

:::

### item {#item}

::: member

Draws an item centered on a point, like an item frame shows it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | item to draw, not null |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the center |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the center |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the center |
| `scale` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | 1 for half a block |

:::

### item {#item-2}

::: member

Draws an item by its ID, see [`item(ScriptItemStack, double, double, double, double)`](#item).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `itemId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | item ID, e.g. `"minecraft:diamond"` |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the center |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the center |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the center |
| `scale` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | 1 for half a block |

:::

### block {#block}

::: member

Draws a block with its default state as a full block whose lowest corner is at the point, lit like the world there.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blockId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, e.g. `"minecraft:stone"` |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X of the lowest corner |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y of the lowest corner |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z of the lowest corner |

:::
